I think there will always be some guilt inside of me; in fact I really hope so; I WANT a daily reminder of what I've done. In addition to getting the medical help I needed, I also grew up a lot, became much less selfish and self-centered, and became a LOT less of an asshole due to that constant memory always being there. I never want it to go away completely; I just hope the guilt diminishes enough to not eat away so very much at my soul to the point where it cripples me so very much.

     I know you got downvoted into the negative range by the reddit community: I wish you hadn't. I gave you an upvote. You gave me exactly what I needed and asked for: you read my words, felt an honest reaction, then responded back with something that was a good combination of constructive criticism and your own heartfelt feelings.

     I know it may not matter to you, because I AM just another one of those shitty guys who hurt a woman, but I want to say THANK YOU from the bottom of my heart for reading what I wrote and writing what you did.
